title: Queue a graph from a script
hook: Five steps and a short script: set values, post, wait, check the status, and download the right file, with the traps each step avoids.

verified.claim: The body fields of POST /prompt and its replies.
A client prompt_id must be a canonical lowercase UUID, or the server returns invalid_prompt_id.
Messages to a client with no socket are dropped.
An upload that clashes gets a numbered name unless overwrite is set.
/view refuses a leading slash or two dots with 400, and a subfolder that leaves the folder with 403.
The official example connects its socket before queueing.
SaveImage with the prefix university/first reports subfolder university and filename first_00001_.png.

unchecked: The script listing was compiled but not run against a live server, because this course makes no live calls.
The lab's stub invents the temp file name and the number of polls.
